name: Jérémy Lanfranchi
bio: I lead field marketing at GitGuardian & shoot pictures, sometimes.
intro: I trained as an industrial and mechanical designer, then spent two years in car manufacturing at Renault. From there I left for urban sport: a freestyle scooter brand and a media company. 3D through manufacturing, photography, team and travel. That work pulled me into growth marketing. Same loop, now in tech: invent, design, prototype, industrialize.

crafts.title: Invent
crafts.line: Brands and companies that did not exist yet.

crafts.title: Design
crafts.line: Seats, magazines, pictures: giving a thing its form.

crafts.title: Prototype
crafts.line: Build it, put it in the world, see if it holds.

crafts.title: Industrialize
crafts.line: Growth loops that keep running. Then showing up where people already are.
